author: DistroTube
description:
For decades, Linux enthusiasts have dreamed of "the Year of the Linux Desktop." Despite Linux powering much of the internet, if not most of the internet, as well as cloud computing, and even Android, desktop Linux has remained a niche choice for most computer users. But artificial intelligence may finally change that.
